item.title: Friday Morning, Oct 16
item.description:
The Friday morning edition of Gumshoe News Radio for October 16, 2026, with overnight developments including the Bend, Oregon school shooting, pre-market futures, and local news for Londonderry and southern New Hampshire. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.
